scientific_limitations: Requires calibrated positive D and distinct positive drift relaxation rates a>b, with common Poisson switching and independent Brownian noises.
Only exact stationary ensemble moment identifiability, not finite-sample accuracy, non-Poisson clocks, or interacting particles.
The model stationary mixture and forward correlations are established prior work; the new claim is global inverse identifiability and the exact feasible region.
title: Global two-observable recovery of unequal switching rates in a shared harmonic trap
